# Licensecc documentation

> Licensecc provides a native C/C++ licensing runtime plus optional online
> services and Python, .NET, and Java verification SDKs. The repository is
> AGPL-3.0-or-later. Follow the linked authority for the surface you change.

- [Choose a workflow](/en/latest/usage/repository-workflows.html)

- [Issue licenses](/en/latest/usage/issue-licenses.html)
